note: Re-judged independently against RFC 4301 Section 6 paragraphs 1 and 2 after the row corrected the paragraph reference. Tested: "MUST be explicitly accounted for using SPD entries"; Gap: "Disposition of non-error, ICMP messages" (split by case: transit ICMPv6 non-error messages, owned by plan/release/validation/spec-ipsec-fragment-receive-and-kernel-proof.md). Producer: internal/component/ike/engine/spd_policy.go::spdTransitPolicies (projects operator SPD entries onto FWD decisions and transit gates). Both tagged tests enforce the declared ICMPv4 scope: TestRFC4301OperatorBypassForwardsTransitEchoInClear proves unmatched transit Echo Requests are dropped in both directions under unmatched discard and forwarded in clear once an operator ICMP BYPASS is verified and installed; TestRFC4301ForwardedICMPErrorUnderOperatorDiscardMapsToReturnSA proves an operator out DISCARD drops a forwarded Echo Request (XfrmOutPolBlock +1) without mapping it to the Child SA.
